area: Wave 6 review, UI, help and score: the Help on hover engine in dialogs, the faded path steps, the write and confirmation-phrase help, the HAR privacy wording, the quality score tool and the Data Flow Map motion model
title: Review fixes (wave 6, UI side): Esc and focus in dialogs, faded step contrast, the four write gates, the phrase help, HAR wording, failing tests cap the grade, every test file in an area, missing records warned

checks.what: With a help pop-up shown, Esc closes only the pop-up in the typed-confirmation dialog and in Find anything; with none shown, Esc still cancels them
Focus in a dialog's text field or a combobox opens no pop-up over the dialog; hover does, and a dialog button still opens its help on focus
Path steps drawn as not reached, not in scope and pending keep their title and line at 4.5:1 in both themes
The write line names write mode, a writer, the named assessor and the confirmation; no entry says Nothing to type and gets a typed-phrase line
The confirmation-phrase help and error say to type the phrase as shown, never underscores, never that the consent step leaves the tenant alone
Every statement of what a HAR import sends names every field runHar posts and what stays in the browser
A failed or errored test caps the grade at C and the words say how many failed
Every tests/test_*.py file is in a sub-area or listed as regression-only, and no test glob is dead
A findings record the formula names but the repository lacks is warned; c6-ui-core now has its record
The Data Flow Map model checks blocked, unverified and decrypted_other against the summary; the motion engine has no unused constant
The committed score files match their inputs on a clean checkout (quality_score.py --check)

findings.title: Esc that closed a help pop-up also cancelled the typed-confirmation dialog or closed Find anything, and focus in those fields opened the pop-up over the dialog's buttons and the result list
findings.fix: static/hover_help.js: an Esc that closes the pop-up is consumed (preventDefault, stopImmediatePropagation); a text field in an open dialog or a combobox opens it on hover only

findings.title: Live path steps drawn as not reached, not in scope or pending faded their text to 1.5 to 3.6:1, yet they are focusable buttons
findings.fix: static/flow_anim.css: only the outline fades (dotted or dashed); the title and line keep full --text and --dim

findings.title: The help line of every write control named three gates (no writer) and promised a typed confirmation that self-heal Undo does not ask for; heal and queue apply left out the writer or the assessor
findings.fix: static/hover_help.js names write mode, a writer, the named assessor and the confirmation; the heal, Undo and queue apply entries name their writer and assessor

findings.title: The confirmation-phrase help and the dialog's error said to type it with the underscores (I UNDERSTAND has a space), and the help called the consent step tenant-free
findings.fix: help_catalog.js: Type the phrase shown above exactly as shown, with a new confirm effect line; ui_auth.js: Type it exactly as shown above

findings.title: The HAR import help, button title, OVERVIEW and server comment said only host names and request counts are sent; methods, schemes and upload amounts are sent too
findings.fix: One list everywhere: host names, request counts, HTTP methods, schemes and upload amounts are sent; cookies, headers, URL paths and bodies stay in the browser

findings.title: The quality score never capped the grade for failing tests: a run with one failure per file still read Grade A, Tests pass
findings.fix: tools/quality_score.py: any failed or errored test caps the score at 79 (grade C at best) and the words start with how many failed

findings.title: The score's sub-area test globs missed every Wave 6 QA file, so their failures never lowered the area they test, and test_bypass*.py matched nothing
findings.fix: tools/quality_score.py: Wave 6 files mapped to their sub-areas, the dead glob removed, the rest listed as REGRESSION_ONLY

findings.title: The score mapped a c6-ui-core record that did not exist, so the UI core fixes were never counted, and nothing warned
findings.fix: docs/qa/findings/c6-ui-core.json written from commit 65bac56; quality_score.py warns when a named record has no file

findings.title: docs/OVERVIEW.md implied the score's tests part was always shown; it needs a recorded docs/qa/test_run.json
findings.fix: docs/OVERVIEW.md names docs/qa/test_run.json, how to write it, No score yet and every cap

findings.title: The Data Flow Map model checked only five of its classes against the summary (not blocked, unverified, decrypted_other) and kept an unused SSL_UNVERIFIED list
findings.fix: static/flow_anim.js: the mismatch check covers every summary class; SSL_UNVERIFIED deleted; three precedence routes pinned

findings.title: The committed docs/QUALITY_SCORE.md and docs/quality_score.json were stale (a fixed high still capped the score at 69), so --check failed on a clean checkout
findings.fix: Both outputs regenerated and committed after the record changes
